summary.result: With analytical results, this paper provides policy implications for Korea’s future negotiation.
summary.background: Under article 6 of the Paris Agreement, parties are allowed flexible methods to meet their nationally determined contribution (NDC) target.
summary.method: In the negotiation, an essential issue is the baseline methodology to be adopted or prioritized of four representative methodologies of i) business‐as‐usual (BAU)‐based methodology, ii) historical emission methodology, iii) performance‐based methodology, and iv) best‐available technology (BAT) methodology.
